FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Creative Horizon Agency, we specialize in providing comprehensive advertising solutions tailored to the unique needs of our clients across various industries. Our core operations include strategy development, creative design, media planning, and digital marketing services. We utilize a data-driven approach to optimize client campaigns, ensuring compliance with all advertising regulations. Our team of experienced professionals conducts thorough content reviews and employs robust cybersecurity protocols to protect sensitive client information. We prioritize formal contracts to outline project scope and deliverables, minimizing the potential for disputes. Additionally, we train our staff on advertising laws and data privacy to further mitigate risks, positioning ourselves as a trusted partner in driving brand success.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any unresolved legal actions related to false or misleading advertising and confirms that we have robust cyber liability insurance and documented cybersecurity protocols in place. Additionally, we maintain a strict policy against making unsubstantiated claims in our advertisements and have a proven track record of consistently meeting client specifications.
